correctness.rationale: With m=(q-1)/2 and p≥5, x^m=chi(x) in Fq. Four character signs sum to an integer in [-4,4]; vanishing mod p is equivalent to integer zero. Write A_q=1+(q-1)#C and use Fourier character orthogonality to extract [T^0] of a four-fold convolution. For nonzero frequencies Fourier factors are u+chi(t)beta G, G²=chi(-1)q; split epsilon=±1, use exact Laurent coefficients [T^0] f0^4, u^4, u²beta², beta^4. Independent symbolic algebra verified both all-q polynomial coefficient identities, yielding 3(q-1)^2/8 or 3(q²-4q+11)/8 by q mod4. Coordinate-axis signs force no points when chi(-1)=+1 and exactly [0:1:-1] and permutations when chi(-1)=-1. Smoothness/geometric integrality follow the reconstructed derivative/Frobenius contradiction, p>3. Direct brute enumeration over thirteen prime fields corroborated; extension fields included analytically, not independently enumerated in this run.
